text:
sara_support: Customer reports project dashboard shows a promotional balance card for project 'acme-widget' but when they call the usage/billing API with the service key they get zero applied and invoices show normal charges. Customer says this started after promo code redemption yesterday. Asked for account ID and service key.

devon_billing: Can you drop the account id + project id + service key here? I'll check the metering logs and promo propagation. If possible include the promo code and approximate redemption time.

sara_support: Account: 88-ACME, Project: acme-widget, Service key: sk-prod-xxxx, Promo: ACMEFREE24, redeemed around 2026-02-14T16:20Z. Customer sent screenshots of the dashboard with the promo card visible (screenshot attached in thread). :mag_right:

kai_infra: Quick note — sometimes the UI reads a cached allocation from the grants service while the metering pipeline lag leads to no immediate consumption credit records. I'll tail the grants-to-metrics sync job for that account. Could be a pipeline backlog or a missing mapping for service keys.

rachel_engineer: Repro steps request — could the customer run a simple generation call with the service key and send us the request-id from the error/response headers? e.g.

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"input":"Hello"}'
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -i
```

We need the X-Request-Id and the HTTP response. That will prove whether tokens are being debited or if the API is reading a zero balance and returning 402/insufficient-credits.

sara_support: Customer ran it, sent back response headers: X-Request-Id: req_20260214_7701, HTTP/1.1 200 OK. Body shows model output. No 402. They say meter dashboard still shows no usage entries for the service key.

devon_billing: Okay looks like usage is being accepted (200) but not being attributed to the promo credit. Two hypotheses: 1) Promo grant attached at org level but not mapped to service-key-level billing, or 2) Grant TTL/effective window mismatch (promo not effective for service keys created earlier/later). I'll query the grants service and the projection that drives the invoicing pipeline. Escalating to billing-pipeline runbook.

billing-bot: Triggered job: analytics.reconcile.promos(account=88-ACME) queued (job id: job_55678). ETA ~ 2min. :gear:

kai_infra: I'm seeing a backlog in the grants->metering topic around 2026-02-14T16:15-16:40Z. Some messages failed to commit due to a transient DB timeout on promotions-db. I requeued and replayed; consumer lag should clear in ~5min. I'll post offsets after replay.

devon_billing: After replay, I can see a grant record for ACMEFREE24 scoped to project 'acme-widget' with amount 150 USD credit and effective_from 2026-02-14T16:20Z. Metering projection now has a mapping entry. I also see two consumption events for the service key with request ids req_20260214_7701 and req_20260214_7707; they were previously un-attributed. I'm forcing a reprocessing pass for those events so they get applied to promo balance.

sara_support: Customer asked if they will see credits applied retroactively and whether any invoice adjustments will occur.

devon_billing: Yes — once reprocessing completes, the UI and API should reflect the applied promo credits. Any invoices already generated will be adjusted via a credit note. I'll monitor the reprocessing job (job id: job_55679) and update when done. ETA ~10-15min.

rachel_engineer: Follow-up: adding an automated alert for lag > 2min on grants->metering topic and a runbook link to the promo DB timeout error. Suggest adding a metric to surface un-attributed consumption events so support can triage faster.

kai_infra: Replay finished. Offsets advanced. Reprocessing job applied promo to 2 events. API usage endpoint now shows usage lines with 'applied_promo: "ACMEFREE24"' for those requests.

sara_support: Verified with customer — they now see the promo balance decreased by two small usage items and overall dashboard reflects remaining promo credit. Customer thanks the team. :tada:

devon_billing: Closing the incident, will follow up with billing adjustments for any generated invoices. Adding post-incident note in #postmortems about the transient promotions-db timeout and consumer retry settings.

sara_support: Marking resolved in case notes, will ping if customer sees any further mismatches. :white_check_mark:
